title: Camp field drawing
prompt: Create one complete 16:9 documentary image for CAMP CENTURY. Image1 establishes the OWNER-APPROVED DRAWING STYLE ONLY: confident detailed ink and charcoal linework, restrained watercolor, paper tooth, blue-white snow, olive winter clothes, sparse rusty ochre objects. Do not copy its composition or subjects unless requested. Any additional image is FACT reference only. Match the drawing style, not a new design system. Full finished composition, large explanatory drawing, legible short English labels integrated into the scene/paper. An authored field notebook drawing of the REAL Camp Century settlement, based on the additional source reference high-level arrangement, not a weapons installation. Large oblique cutaway of a main snow corridor and several side corridors housing timber rooms, with the surface ramp in foreground. Carefully drawn corrugated arches, snow surrounding the rooms, small workers giving scale. Four integrated labels only: MAIN PASSAGE; ROOMS; UTILITIES; SURFACE RAMP. This is a conceptual three-dimensional view, not a surveyed plan, so no invented street numbers, dimensions or scale bar. Complete drawing fills 90 percent. All base artwork must be CLEAN: NO yellow highlighting, NO underlines, NO marker strokes, NO selection circles, NO loupes, NO glow or animated accents baked into the image; those are added later in DaVinci Resolve. No generic three-line title card, UI, HUD, floating boxes, fake official seals/signatures/stamps, tiny filler text, placeholders, empty panels, decorative noise or burnt parchment. Use 6 percent safe margins. This is authored explanatory artwork, not an original archival record. No invented quantities, dimensions or measurement curves. No other projects or bases. Text only as explicitly specified.
